captureValidation.cvarCheck: r_drawBuffer reads GL_FRONT before and after devmap fakkhouse (gl-private-stall/front-cvar).

captureSequences.note: Six screenshotPNG requests 150 ms apart (Ritual wait) through the options menu opening; mean channel change between neighbouring captures, rows 310-599.

gpuSelection.fntech3: code/win32/win_main.cpp exports NvOptimusEnablement = 1 and AmdPowerXpressRequestHighPerformance = 1; GL ran on the NVIDIA GPU in every fnTech3 run.
gpuSelection.exportValueIgnored: A copy of fntech3.exe 18a9ce89... with only NvOptimusEnablement set to 0 (file offset 0x910070; sha256 5ce7dfd5ab794950...) still ran GL on NVIDIA: recorded with SHIM_MCCOMPAT=0x800000000 (unlocked-1/fn-fakk2-glx-optimus0-integrated), and once without it in a folder a later run reused. Renaming both export names as well (sha256 62e7b730afaf4878..., unlocked-1/fn-fakk2-glx-optimus0) gave Intel Iris Xe, so driver 591.74 goes by the export being present, not by its value.
gpuSelection.shimMccompat: SHIM_MCCOMPAT=0x800000001 put python.exe (wgl_swap_probe.py) and retail fakk2.exe on NVIDIA; 0x800000000 or nothing left them on Intel.
gpuSelection.retail: Retail fakk2.exe 1.02 exports neither symbol and runs GL on Intel Iris Xe by default.
gpuSelection.vulkan: r_device -1 picks the NVIDIA device, -2 the Intel one (renderervk/vk.c).

open: Not run: the same matrix while the session is locked (the user declined on 2026-09-25). Vulkan, Intel GL, retail fakk2.exe on NVIDIA and a bare WGL loop on NVIDIA have not been timed under a lock.

Lock and display-off cannot be told apart from these runs: every locked run started more than a minute after the lock, when the console display is normally off. A display that times out in an unlocked session is untested.
